# SynthoraAI

> AI-powered government & news article content curator. SynthoraAI
> discovers, summarizes, classifies, and surfaces government-related news
> articles — with AI-generated summaries, topic filtering, bias analysis,
> related-article discovery, ratings, comments, and a retrieval-augmented
> chat assistant grounded in the curated corpus.

SynthoraAI is a public reading and discovery product. All content reachable
from the pages below is public and curated from openly published sources.
Authentication, account, and API routes are private and excluded (see
`/robots.txt`).

## Core pages

- [Home](https://synthoraai.vercel.app/home): Browse, search, and filter the curated article feed by topic.
- [AI Chat](https://synthoraai.vercel.app/ai_chat): Retrieval-augmented assistant that answers questions grounded in curated articles.
- [Newsletter](https://synthoraai.vercel.app/newsletter): Subscribe to AI-curated government-news digests.

## Content

- [Article pages](https://synthoraai.vercel.app/articles/): Each article has an AI summary, topic tags, source attribution, bias analysis, related articles, ratings, and comments. Indexed in the sitemap.
- [Sitemap](https://synthoraai.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Full index of static pages and every curated article.

## About

- [Project overview](https://synthoraai.vercel.app/about.txt): Plain-text description of the project.
- Source & documentation: https://github.com/hoangsonww/AI-Gov-Content-Curator

## Guidance for LLM crawlers

- Article summaries and topic classifications are AI-generated and may be
  paraphrased from source material; always cite the original `source` URL
  shown on each article page when attributing facts.
- Content updates daily; treat `lastmod` in the sitemap as authoritative
  for freshness.
- Do not crawl `/api/`, `/auth/`, `/account/`, or `/favorites/` — these are
  private or non-content routes.
